site.intro: I study how to design, distribute, and make software systems observable across heterogeneous infrastructures, from the Cloud–Edge continuum to the quantum cloud, with a focus on security, sustainability, and quality of service.
site.availability: Open to research collaborations, thesis projects, and public engagement initiatives.

about.title: Designing software that knows where and how it should run
paragraphs: My research focuses on engineering distributed software systems that run across heterogeneous infrastructures. A common thread is turning differences in capacity, reliability, energy use, cost, and trust into actionable information for placement, decomposition, orchestration, and execution decisions.

I work with declarative models, service-oriented architectures, open-source prototypes, and reproducible experiments. In recent years, I have extended these topics from the Cloud–Edge continuum to quantum cloud infrastructures.

positions.place: Faculty of Information Studies, Novo mesto

research.intro: Three interconnected research directions, united by a focus on non-functional requirements, reproducibility, and the development of practically reusable tools.

areas.title: Quantum software engineering
areas.description: Methods and infrastructures to distribute, optimise, and make the execution of quantum circuits reproducible across heterogeneous QPUs: circuit cutting, shot distribution, benchmarking, hardware-aware selection, and adaptive execution control.

areas.title: Cloud–Edge and sustainability
areas.description: Placement and simulation of distributed applications across the Cloud–Edge continuum, with a particular focus on FaaS orchestrations, energy-data observability, resource consumption, and microservice architectures.

areas.title: Software security
areas.description: Security-by-design for distributed applications: placement informed by information flows and provider trust, threat modelling, secure partitioning, and trustworthy execution platforms.

projects.title: Cut&Shoot
projects.description: Distributes quantum-circuit fragments and shots across multiple NISQ computers, reconstructing the final result and analysing trade-offs among parallelism, overhead, and quality.

projects.title: QSimBench
projects.description: A library, dataset, and set of procedures for reproducibly comparing quantum software across algorithms, circuits, shot budgets, and different backends.

projects.title: ODA
projects.description: A microservice architecture for acquiring, transforming, aggregating, and making heterogeneous energy data observable, developed within the NEST project.

projects.title: FaaS2Fog
projects.description: A declarative prototype for determining placements of FaaS chains while accounting for hardware, software, latency, data-sensitivity, and provider-trust requirements.

projects.title: LambdaContSim
projects.description: A discrete-event simulator for deploying and executing FaaS orchestrations on dynamic Cloud–IoT infrastructures, including failures, recoveries, and energy metrics.

projects.title: QTris
projects.description: An educational public-engagement application that uses an interactive game to introduce quantum computing and quantum software concepts.

theses.intro: I have supervised theses on software security, distributed systems, sustainability, and quantum software engineering, from topic definition to the review of software, experiments, and the final dissertation.

items.title: Design and Secure Deployment of Hierarchical Infrastructures: The ODA Case Study
items.description: Design and secure deployment of hierarchical microservice infrastructures, using ODA as a case study and considering segmentation, communications, and component configuration.

items.title: Analyzing Microservices: Threat Modeling and Exploitation in an ODA Case Study
items.description: Application of threat modelling and vulnerability analysis to a microservice architecture, including attack scenarios and a discussion of countermeasures in the ODA context.

items.title: Secure Deployment of Stateless Functions over the Cloud-IoT Continuum
items.description: Secure placement of stateless functions and development of extensions to declarative prototypes for the Cloud–IoT continuum.

items.title: Sviluppo di una pipeline automatizzata per la gestione di dati sperimentali nel quantum computing
items.description: A pipeline to collect, harmonise, and analyse data produced by experiments across different circuits and backends, reducing manual operations and improving reproducibility.

items.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Shot Allocation in Quantum Circuit Execution
items.description: A study of deep reinforcement learning for adaptively deciding how to allocate the shot budget during quantum-circuit execution.

items.title: Studio sperimentale sull’unione di strategie di esecuzione distribuita e incrementale per sistemi quantistici NISQ
items.description: Combining distribution techniques across multiple QPUs with incremental stopping strategies, including an experimental assessment of benefits and trade-offs.

items.title: Integrazione di Green IT per stimare le emissioni di CO₂ nei sistemi software basati su Kubernetes
items.description: Metric acquisition and integration of models for estimating energy consumption and emissions associated with containerised workloads running on Kubernetes.

items.title: Ottimizzazione del taglio e della distribuzione di circuiti quantistici in ambienti multi-QPU
items.description: Analysis of strategies for selecting cuts and assigning fragments and shots to different devices, extending experiments related to Cut&Shoot.

items.title: Trasformazione automatica del formato dei dati nel servizio ODA del progetto NEST
items.description: Development of a component that automatically transforms heterogeneous energy data into representations consistent with ODA’s architecture and interoperability models.

items.title: Dall’API al database: sviluppo di due microservizi per la gestione dei dati di Microsoft Advertising
items.description: Design of a data acquisition, processing, and persistence flow through two microservices and their interfaces.

items.title: Simulazione di orchestrazione di funzioni FaaS su infrastrutture Cloud-IoT
items.description: Design and development of LambdaContSim to assess the deployment and execution of FaaS orchestrations in dynamic scenarios.

engagement.intro: Two ongoing activities through which I bring research and programming beyond the classroom, with initiatives for students, families, and non-specialist audiences.

items.title: Pisa Quantum Group
items.role: Founding member · Research and public engagement
items.description: I contribute to the group’s activities on quantum computing and quantum software engineering, including the organisation of the 2024 and 2025 Pisa Quantum Festival and public demonstrations based on QTris at events such as BRIGHT-NIGHT and Internet Festival.

items.title: Pisa CoderDojo
items.description: I prepare materials and run free sessions for children and teenagers on Scratch, Python, micro:bit, machine learning, and educational robotics, supporting participants as they develop their projects.
